The Court made the following:
ORDER:
The instant Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed, by the Petitioners/A.2 to A.10, seeking to quash the Proceedings against them in CC No.19 of 2021 on the file of the Court of Judicial First class Magistrate, Darsi, for the offences punishable under Sections 466, 467, 471, 409, 420, 120(B) read with 109 IPC.

entities.text: Court of Judicial First class Magistrate, Darsi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The allegation levelled against the Petitioners/A.2 to A.10 is that they along with A.1 colluded with each other with criminal conspiracy and committed criminal breach of trust and cheated the de facto complainant and remaining members of the Association for their unlawful gain with common intention.
Heard Sri P.Nagendra learned counsel for the Petitioners and Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent No.1/State and learned counsel for respondent No.2.
Perused the material on record.

sentences.text: At the time of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioners restricted the prayer and requested to dispense with the presence of the Petitioners before the Trial Court and this criminal petition may be disposed of by giving liberty to the Petitioners to raise such contentions before the trial Court in defence.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the Court may pass appropriate orders.

Considering the submissions made, the Criminal Petition is disposed of and the Petitioners are at liberty to raise the contentions before the trial Court in their defence and the learned Magistrate shall take an appropriate decision over the matter according to law.
However, the presence of the Petitioners/A.2 to A.10 before the trial Court is dispensed with, except on the specific dates as directed by the trial Court.
Pending applications, if any, shall stand closed.
